just_in.title: Bommai Kolu: A Diaspora Guide to South India's Navratri Doll Display
just_in.excerpt: From the kalasam on the top step to the marapachi couple, how Tamil, Telugu and Kannada families build the tiered doll court that anchors Navratri — and how to start one in a US or UK home.

steps.detail: Kolu is arranged on an odd number of tiers — 3, 5, 7, 9 or 11. First-timers can start with 3 or 5 using a stand, stacked boxes or a bookshelf covered with cloth.
Fill a pot with water and rice, add betel leaves, a coin and turmeric, ring the mouth with mango leaves and top with a turmeric-smeared coconut. Light a lamp before placing any dolls.
The wooden bride-and-groom pair, often passed down through generations, goes on the top steps first.
Deities and sacred figures take the upper tiers; saints, wedding scenes, animals and everyday life fill the steps below.

steps.step: Add one new doll each year
steps.detail: The annual addition marks abundance and keeps the display growing with the family.

steps.detail: Invite friends and neighbours to view the display, sing devotional songs and share prasadam such as sundal.

nri-world.image_caption: A Chennai Metro train (file photo) — PM Modi and Tamil Nadu CM Vijay inaugurated the Poonamallee Bypass–Vadapalani stretch of Phase 2 on October 11, cutting the trip to about 30 minutes.
nri-world.nri_angle: NRIs arriving in Chennai get a fast, cheap new rail link to the western suburbs and industrial belt, with direct interchange to the airport and Central station.

nri-world.title: 11-Day Mysuru Dasara Begins With Traditional Inauguration at Chamundi Hills

nri-world.image_caption: A decorated elephant carries the golden howdah during the Jamboo Savari procession in Mysuru. The 2026 Mysuru Dasara festivities began October 11 and run through Vijayadashami on October 21.

nri-world.title: Assam-Born Scientist Builds Detectors for NASA Telescope That Will Hunt for Life Beyond Earth
nri-world.excerpt: Dr. Angaraj Duara is developing CMOS image detectors at the Open University for potential use on NASA's Habitable Worlds Observatory, the first large telescope designed to search for life on other worlds.
nri-world.image_caption: A NASA telescope that will hunt for signs of life on distant exoplanets. An Assam-born scientist built its detectors.
nri-world.nri_angle: Duara's trajectory — Assam to Leicester to a NASA flagship mission with UK Space Agency funding — is a working blueprint for Indian STEM talent abroad, and his public lectures carry the science back to India as well.

nri-world.title: From Bakery Shifts to Seven-Figure Revenue: One Indian Founder's Australian Climb
nri-world.excerpt: Yatin Jindal arrived in Australia at 18 with no network and worked bakery, convenience-store and security shifts. Four years after founding Digital Route, he says the agency has served 50-plus property professionals and driven $12.5 million in client revenue.
nri-world.image_caption: The young Indian founder behind the Australian business success story. He went from working bakery shifts to building seven-figure revenue in four years.
nri-world.nri_angle: Jindal's story follows a classic diaspora arc — arriving young with no network, working survival jobs, then building a business — with the notable twist of breaking into Australia's referral-heavy property sector purely on measurable results.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: NRI University Team Beats 65,000 to Win Global Quantum Challenge
nri-world.excerpt: Three data-science students from Dr. RVR NRI Institute of Technology in Andhra Pradesh took the top prize at the WISER Vanguard Global Challenge with THRINETRA, a project applying quantum technology to workforce management.
nri-world.image_caption: A quantum computer in a research lab. An NRI university team beat 65,000 entrants to win a global quantum challenge.
nri-world.nri_angle: A Washington DC-based institute training 50,000-plus Andhra Pradesh students shows a genuine India-US quantum bridge, and proves to NRIs that Indian universities are now producing world champions in frontier technology.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

immigration.title: UK Universities Withdraw Offers to Indian and Other Students as Visa Refusals Rise
immigration.excerpt: With sponsor licences now at risk above a 5% visa refusal rate, universities are revoking offers pre-emptively — withdrawn applications from Indian students rose to 5.2% in the first half of 2026.
immigration.image_caption: The Radcliffe Camera at the University of Oxford. UK universities are withdrawing offers to international students to protect their sponsor licences as visa refusals rise.
immigration.nri_angle: Indian applicants are caught in a UK compliance squeeze: withdrawals of Indian study-visa applications quadrupled to 5.2%, and some universities have added extra screening for Indian applicants.
immigration.author: Diaspora Desk

immigration.title: PERM vs H-1B: What the Green-Card Freeze Means for Indian Tech Workers
immigration.excerpt: The US has barred eight major tech and IT-services firms, including Microsoft and TCS, from the labor-certification step of the green-card process. Here's how PERM differs from H-1B and what changes for Indian professionals.
immigration.image_caption: An editorial illustration shows US President Donald Trump at a podium alongside a US green card and a PERM labor certification form stamped SUSPENDED. The Trump administration has suspended the PERM green-card program for eight major tech firms including Microsoft and TCS, while existing H-1B visas remain unaffected.
immigration.nri_angle: The PERM freeze directly affects Indian tech workers at eight named US employers by blocking new employer-sponsored green-card filings while leaving H-1B status intact.
immigration.author: Diaspora Desk

immigration.title: HUD's FHA Crackdown Shuts Out Visa Holders as Home Loans Fall to Near Zero
immigration.excerpt: Non-permanent residents went from 5.8% of FHA purchase originations to 0.1% after the May 2025 rule change — and conventional lending has not picked up the slack.
immigration.image_caption: The Robert C. Weaver Federal Building, HUD headquarters in Washington, D.C. (Wikimedia Commons)
immigration.nri_angle: With Indians receiving roughly 70% of H-1B approvals, the FHA lockout hits the Indian diaspora's largest professional cohort directly — and in exactly the tech markets (San Jose, Salt Lake City, Raleigh) where Indian engineers buy their first American homes.
immigration.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: Indian Shares Lifted as Oil Eases and RBI's Rupee Defence Kicks In
markets-finance.excerpt: The rupee jumped about 1% at Monday's open as the RBI's special dollar window for oil companies took effect and Brent slipped to $103 — though markets closed lower as crude stayed above $100 and foreign selling continued.
markets-finance.nri_angle: For NRIs remitting money, the rupee's RBI-backed bounce matters at the margin: the currency opened near 95.77 per dollar after closing Friday at 96.73, so timing a transfer this week could move the received amount by roughly 1%.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: Wall Street's top bosses shrug off rupee slide to double down on India
markets-finance.excerpt: Blackstone expects to double its India assets to $100 billion while Brookfield plans to deploy over $100 billion in five years — even as foreign investors pull $30 billion from Indian stocks.
markets-finance.nri_angle: The boom is powered as much by Indian domestic savings as Wall Street capital — investors should note the split between record IPO liquidity and sticky local flows on one side, and currency depreciation plus $30B in foreign outflows on the other.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: Weak US Jobs Report Pushes October Fed Rate Hike Odds Below 25%
markets-finance.excerpt: Just 29,000 jobs added in September against 90,000 expected, with steep downward revisions — futures markets now see the Fed standing pat at its October 27-28 meeting.
markets-finance.image_caption: The Marriner S. Eccles Federal Reserve building in Washington, D.C. A weak September jobs report pushed October Fed rate-hike odds below 25%.
markets-finance.nri_angle: NRI portfolios face the real tension: a Fed likely on hold in October but hiking in December keeps US mortgage rates elevated while supporting rate-sensitive equities — watch the December meeting, not October's.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

items.label: Jobs Revised Down in Prior Two Months

markets-finance.title: Musk Vows Affordable Starlink in India, Escalating Feud With Ambani Before Jio's Record IPO
markets-finance.excerpt: In X posts, Elon Musk promised affordable satellite internet to take on Reliance Jio, saying competition would benefit ordinary Indians — days before Jio Platforms' record $106 billion IPO.
markets-finance.image_caption: Elon Musk at a formal event. Musk said SpaceX will price Starlink affordably in India to take on Reliance Jio, days before Jio Platforms' record IPO.
markets-finance.nri_angle: A Starlink–Jio price war in satellite broadband could finally bring reliable high-speed access to rural areas where even 4G is patchy — directly changing what video calls home look like for diaspora families — while Jio's record IPO gives global investors direct exposure to the outcome.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: Japan Overtakes Singapore as India's Top FDI Source With $5.71 Billion in Q1
markets-finance.excerpt: DPIIT data shows Japan invested $5.71 billion in April–June 2026 — nearly 29% of India's total equity FDI and more than it invested in all of FY26 — while US inflows collapsed 76%.
markets-finance.image_caption: Soldiers carry the flags of India and Japan during an honour-guard ceremony. Japan invested $5.71 billion in India in the April–June 2026 quarter, becoming its largest source of foreign direct investment.
markets-finance.nri_angle: The India–Japan capital corridor is thickening: two major Indian private banks now have Japanese anchor shareholders, and the 10-trillion-yen pipeline points to years of deployment. For US-based NRIs, the 76% collapse in American inflows is the flag — India-bound capital is changing nationality.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: Jio sets IPO price band at ₹1,065–1,119 for ₹10.3 lakh crore valuation
markets-finance.excerpt: Reliance Industries' digital arm plans to open subscriptions on October 21, aiming to raise about ₹30,200 crore in what would be India's largest-ever IPO — with no offer-for-sale by existing investors.
markets-finance.image_caption: An editorial illustration of a Jio telecom tower with stock tickers and IPO documents. Jio has set its IPO price band at Rs 1,065-1,119 per share, valuing the company at about Rs 10.3 lakh crore.
markets-finance.nri_angle: As India's largest-ever IPO and a barometer of global appetite for Indian equity, the Jio listing is accessible to non-resident investors through the NRI quota, and its valuation and listing-day performance will shape how the world prices India's digital infrastructure assets.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: Private capital to drive 30 GW of India's 100 GW nuclear target by 2047
markets-finance.excerpt: Atomic Energy Commission chairman A K Mohanty said opening the nuclear sector to private players could draw ₹7.5 lakh crore in investment, as India targets about 22 GW by 2031-32 under its Nuclear Energy Mission.
markets-finance.image_caption: The Kudankulam Nuclear Power Plant in Tamil Nadu. Private firms are expected to contribute 30 GW toward India's 100 GW nuclear capacity target by 2047.
markets-finance.nri_angle: For diaspora investors, nuclear power opens as a new investable theme in India for the first time, as the SHANTI Act lets private companies — including listed Indian engineering and power firms — enter a sector long closed to them, while Indo-US civil nuclear talks could bring American and Canadian reactor makers into the build-out.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: US Lifts Russian Diesel Sanctions Until April 2027 in Trump-Putin Deal
markets-finance.excerpt: Trump announced phased Russian diesel deliveries after a call with Putin; the Treasury authorized Russian-origin diesel transactions through April 7, 2027, weeks before the midterms.
markets-finance.image_caption: A roadside diesel price sign in the US displays $8.289 per gallon as a tanker truck passes on a highway. Washington has temporarily lifted sanctions on Russian diesel sales through April 2027 under a deal announced by President Trump.
markets-finance.nri_angle: Indian refiners — major exporters of diesel and big buyers of Russian crude — could see export margins squeezed if sanctioned-lifted Russian diesel floods global markets.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: Adani Green H1: Capacity Up 24% to 20,763 MW, Energy Sales Jump 32%
markets-finance.excerpt: The renewables major added 4,083 MW of greenfield capacity and commissioned 3,081 MWh of battery storage at Khavda; the board meets October 21 to approve Q2 results.
markets-finance.image_caption: An aerial view shows rows of solar panels at a large solar farm. Adani Green Energy reported operational capacity of 20,763 MW for the first half, up 24% from a year earlier.
markets-finance.nri_angle: Adani stocks are widely held by diaspora investors tracking India's renewable-energy story; the October 21 results are the next checkpoint on that thesis.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: GST Council Axes Arrest Powers, Halves Penalties in Sweeping Compliance Overhaul
markets-finance.excerpt: The 57th Council meeting recommended removing GST officers' arrest powers, raising the prosecution threshold to ₹5 crore, and automating refunds and registrations — with no rate changes on the table.
markets-finance.image_caption: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman addresses a media briefing after the 57th GST Council meeting at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi, on October 8, 2026. The Council recommended removing GST officers’ arrest powers and halving the general penalty.
markets-finance.nri_angle: For NRIs running India operations or investing in Indian SMEs, the compliance overhaul lowers one of the biggest frictions of doing business in India — arbitrary enforcement risk — which is exactly the kind of structural change that moves the needle on India's ease-of-doing-business story.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: Sensex Surges 879 Points as IT Stocks Lead Broad-Based Market Rebound
markets-finance.excerpt: The Sensex and Nifty each gained more than 1% on Friday, led by a 3% IT rally on strong TCS results — but persistent FII selling and Monday's CPI print will decide if the bounce holds.
markets-finance.image_caption: The Bombay Stock Exchange building is shown with rising market arrows. The Sensex gained 879.09 points on October 9, 2026 to close at 72,472.33, while the Nifty 50 rose 1.30% to 22,520.45.
markets-finance.nri_angle: For NRI investors with Indian equity exposure, Friday's bounce cut the week's earlier damage — but with FIIs still selling and the RBI's tightening cycle underway, the recovery hinges on Q2 earnings delivery rather than one day's short covering.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: Deshpande Hat-Trick Bowls Chandigarh Out for 78 as Mumbai Take Command at Wankhede
sports.excerpt: Tushar Deshpande took 5 for 17, including a hat-trick in the 11th over, on day two of the Ranji Trophy season opener — becoming the sixth Mumbai bowler to take a Ranji hat-trick, and the first to do it at the Wankhede.
sports.image_caption: Tushar Deshpande, the Mumbai fast bowler who took a hat-trick and 5 for 17 against Chandigarh at the Wankhede.
sports.nri_angle: The Ranji Trophy opener doubles as an audition stage for India's pace bench, which diaspora fans will watch closely with a New Zealand Test series ahead.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: How Virat Kohli's YouTube Clips Helped Nathan McSweeney Beat India's Spinners
sports.excerpt: The Australia A batter studied Kohli and Steve Smith footage to crack India's spin, scoring 194 runs at 64.66 to win Player of the Series in Australia A's 2-1 ODI win over India A.
sports.image_caption: Nathan McSweeney of Australia A poses with the Player of the Series medal in Puducherry. The 27-year-old studied Virat Kohli's YouTube batting videos to prepare for India's spin, then topped the ODI run charts with 194 runs in three innings.
sports.nri_angle: An Australian batter publicly crediting Virat Kohli's technique as the textbook for surviving Indian spin is a genuine measure of Kohli's influence for diaspora cricket fans — and a small point of pride.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: West Indies' Plan B Against Abhishek Sharma Revealed — and It Failed
sports.excerpt: Shamar Springer admitted the visitors shelved their attacking playbook and tried to starve Abhishek of boundaries. Abhishek knew exactly what was coming — and dismantled it anyway.

sports.title: 20 Goals, Zero Conceded: India U17 Women Storm Into Back-to-Back Asian Cups
sports.excerpt: A 4-0 win over Malaysia sealed a perfect Group E campaign for the Young Tigresses, making them the first Indian side at any age level to qualify for consecutive Women's Asian Cups.
sports.image_caption: India's U17 women's footballers celebrate during the AFC U17 Women's Asian Cup qualifiers. The team scored 20 goals across three wins to qualify for back-to-back Asian Cups, a first for any Indian side.
sports.nri_angle: A landmark the global Indian diaspora can rally behind — the Young Tigresses' flawless 20-goals-for-zero-against campaign gives fans worldwide a team to follow into China 2027.

sports.excerpt: Suryansh Shedge's 66 and Vipraj Nigam's all-round show lifted India A from 159/6 to a 49-run win at Puducherry — Australia A took the series 2–1.
sports.image_caption: A cricket match in progress with the main building of the Hyderabad Public School in the background, in a photograph from the 1940s. sports.nri_angle: India A games are auditions for the senior team — Shedge and Nigam's rescue act puts two IPL-proven youngsters firmly in the selector conversation ahead of the home season diaspora fans follow closely.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: Abhishek's 69 and Arshdeep's Three-Fer Power India to 14-Run Win Over West Indies
sports.excerpt: India defended 223 at Indore's Holkar Stadium to take a 2-1 lead in the five-match T20I series — the first successful defense by the team batting first on this tour.
sports.image_caption: Abhishek Sharma bats for India during the third T20I against the West Indies at Indore. His 30-ball 69 powered India to a 14-run win and a 2-1 series lead.
sports.nri_angle: India take a 2-1 series lead into the fourth T20I — a series-clinching win is now one result away, with Abhishek Sharma and Arshdeep Singh giving diaspora fans the headlines.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: After Bhuvneshwar's Recall at 36, Raina Backs Mohammed Shami for India Comeback
sports.excerpt: The former India batter says Shami is "right behind" Bhuvneshwar Kumar after Bhuvi's age-36 recall — but his comeback case rests on domestic form, not Raina's endorsement.
sports.image_caption: Suresh Raina sits on a blue couch in a cricket-themed studio setting. He backed Mohammed Shami for an India comeback while speaking at the Indian Soft Ball Cricket League jersey launch.
sports.nri_angle: The diaspora's cricket fans follow the New Zealand tour closely — a Shami comeback after years out would be one of the season's biggest stories, and his Ranji opener is the audition to watch.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: Voll's Unbeaten 131 Outshines Mostary's Historic 118 as Australia Seal ODI Series
sports.excerpt: Sobhana Mostary's record 118 — the first century by a Bangladesh woman against Australia — was eclipsed within hours as Georgia Voll's unbeaten 131 powered a nine-wicket win that sealed the series 2-0.
sports.image_caption: Australia opener Georgia Voll, whose unbeaten 131 sealed the ODI series against Bangladesh at Allan Border Field.
sports.nri_angle: For Indian cricket fans tracking the women's game's power curve, this series is essential viewing: Bangladesh's 195-run fightback shows the growing depth India will face in the next World Cup cycle, while Voll's power-hitting masterclass is the benchmark India's own batters are chasing.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: ICC ODI World Cup 2027: India opens against Australia, faces Pakistan on October 10
sports.excerpt: The 14th edition runs October 2 to November 21, 2027 across South Africa, Zimbabwe and Namibia, with 57 matches in 12 venues and a revamped Super Sevens format.
sports.image_caption: Newlands Cricket Ground in Cape Town, where India opens its 2027 ODI World Cup campaign against Australia on October 7.
sports.nri_angle: South Africa's large Indian-origin community will be out in force at Durban and Johannesburg venues, while US-based fans face 4:00 am ET start times for India's matches — and anyone planning travel can register through the ICC's ticket ballot opened alongside the schedule.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: New Zealand Recall Allen, Ferguson and Seifert for India ODI Series
sports.excerpt: Finn Allen and Lockie Ferguson return to the 50-over setup for the first time since 2023, joining the final two ODIs as New Zealand test their depth a year out from the World Cup.
sports.image_caption: New Zealand pacer Lockie Ferguson, recalled for the ODI series against India.
sports.nri_angle: The Auckland and Hamilton fixtures draw strong Indian-diaspora crowds; the split-squad format gives fans two distinct New Zealand lineups to watch against India.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: Ashwin Slams Hope's Tactics: Hosein Spell Like Feeding Goat to Hungry Lion
sports.excerpt: The former India spinner said persisting with Akeal Hosein for three powerplay overs let a struggling Sanju Samson find rhythm — "Samson simply took advantage of the opportunity."
sports.image_caption: Ravichandran Ashwin. The former India off-spinner questioned Shai Hope's captaincy tactics after West Indies' collapse.
sports.nri_angle: Ashwin's YouTube analysis is one of the most watched post-match platforms among Indian cricket fans, and Samson's redemption under selection pressure is a widely debated topic in the diaspora.

sports.excerpt: New Zealand's 25-year-old quick will miss the ODIs and Tests against India as a “precaution,” with the December tour of Australia now his comeback target.
sports.image_caption: New Zealand fast bowler Will O'Rourke in Test whites. The 25-year-old has been ruled out of the home series against India with hamstring and calf injuries.

technology.title: Software developer job postings are rising — but only at the top

technology.image_caption: Software development work. US job postings have risen 15% since February 2025 but remain below pre-pandemic levels.

technology.title: DeepMind's Lila Ibrahim: what young engineers must do to survive AI
technology.excerpt: Google DeepMind's chief AI readiness officer told NDTV that entry-level engineering jobs are drying up as automation takes over routine coding — and the survivors will be the ones who can point to what is irreducibly human in their work.
technology.image_caption: Lila Ibrahim, chief operating officer of Google DeepMind
technology.nri_angle: Indian engineers face the sharpest version of this squeeze — 37% of entry-level tasks already handled or augmented by AI, with fresher campus hiring in multi-year decline.

technology.title: TCS CEO Says Traditional IT Growth Will Taper as AI Revenue Crosses $3 Billion
technology.excerpt: K. Krithivasan's BusinessLine interview puts a number on the pivot — $3 billion in annualized AI revenue, up 19% in a quarter — as the old services model slows.
technology.image_caption: TCS chief executive K. Krithivasan. He told The Hindu BusinessLine that traditional IT services growth will taper as clients shift spending to AI.
technology.nri_angle: TCS employs lakhs of Indians in the US on H-1Bs and green-card queues and was just suspended from the PERM programme; its AI pivot defines what skills keep Indian tech workers employable.

technology.title: Automation Could Shrink US Labor Demand by 36 Million Jobs by 2035, McKinsey Warns

technology.image_caption: An industrial robot at work (file photo) — a McKinsey Global Institute report warns automation could shrink US labor demand by the equivalent of 36 million jobs by 2035.
technology.nri_angle: Indian tech workers in the US face 70% automation adoption of current work hours by 2035; reskilling toward growing fields like healthcare, construction and management is the actionable hedge.

technology.title: India's Semiconductor Market to Hit $200 Billion by 2035 as Five Plants Go Live: EY-IESA
technology.excerpt: The EY-IESA report unveiled at SEMICON India 2026 projects threefold growth as commercial chip production begins at five units, including new lines at Mohali and Surat.

technology.title: Curiosity Captures Martian Sunrise Mirroring Arizona's Monument Valley
